content.title: Start a Fundraiser and Support The Arc
content.text: Fundraise for The Arc Start Today Looking for a way to make a difference in the lives of people with disabilities? Here are some creative and easy ways to support The Arc! Follow a manual added link Facebook FundraisersFollow a manual added link Donation in Lieu of Gifts or Special Event FavorsFollow a manual added link American Express Membership Rewards Facebook FundraisersMaking the world a better place for people with disabilities only takes a few clicks! Why start a Facebook Fundraiser? 100% of the money you raise goes to The Arc. Donor and payment information is secure. It’s a great way to celebrate a birthday, event, anniversary, or milestone. Your friends and family will get involved in the fight for disability rights. You can easily track your progress toward your fundraising goal. If you’re using a smartphone, follow these easy steps: Open the Facebook app on your phone. Search for “Fundraisers” and select “Create a Fundraiser,” then search for “The Arc of the United States” to get started. Donation in Lieu of Gifts or Special Event Favors Make your wedding day or special event more meaningful by donating in honor of your guests or a loved one to The Arc. We’re here to help customize your donation request, from providing language for favor cards to supplying materials and information to distribute to guests. Share your special day by making a difference in the lives of those with disabilities with your special donation. American Express Membership RewardsDid you know you can redeem your American Express Membership Rewards points for a donation to The Arc? Donations can be made in dollars or, if you are enrolled in the Membership Rewards program, you can redeem your points for a donation. For every 1,000 points you redeem, The Arc will receive a $10 donation. Your dollar donation is tax deductible to the extent allowed by law, and you will receive an immediate e-mail receipt that meets IRS requirements as a record of your contribution. If you are enrolled in an American Express Loyalty program, you can earn valuable rewards with virtually every dollar you donate.
